description: The line plot illustrates the growth of vocabulary size over the number of iterations for three language learning tracks—Spanish, Japanese, and an unlabeled gray track—within the DIY-MKG system. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Iterations,” spans from 0 to 500 in linear increments of 100, while the y-axis, labeled “Vocabulary Size,” ranges from 0 to 5000 in linear increments of 1000. The Spanish track is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at (0, 0) and rising to approximately (500, 3000). The Japanese track is shown as a solid green line with circular markers, beginning at (0, 0) and reaching about (500, 3100). The gray track, which lacks a legend label but is visually distinct, follows a steeper linear trajectory, starting at (0, 0) and ending near (500, 5000). All three lines exhibit steady, approximately linear growth, with the gray line consistently above the others throughout the range, and the Japanese line slightly surpassing the Spanish line after approximately 300 iterations.
